column3: Saori Route · Meeting at Akibahara
Two days after the field trip ended.
I went to Akihabara on my day off to give Saori some souvenirs.
She told me over the phone that she also had something to talk about.
What could she be wanting to talk to me about?
The only thing I could think of, naturally, was otaku-related stuff.
For example, things like, "This model is limited to one per person, so I would like you to come with me!".
Or maybe, "I bought a life-size figurine, help me carry it!"
It has to be something like that.
Hey-! Kyousuke-shi～!
Ah, my sincerest apologies! The preparations took me longer than I thought they would.
It's okay, I just got here...
...Wait, what's with those bags?
What's she planning? Is she going to go to war with those huge things?
Here, give me some of those bags, they look heavy.
Don't be concerned, I have it under control!
With that said, shall we depart to a cafe or some such in lieu of idly standing around?
By a cafe you mean...
Heh heh heh...
When she gives this catty smile...
It definitely means we're going there...
...A maid cafe, of course!
Welcome back, Master, Mistress.
Phew... There... we... go...
Saori's backpack looks pretty heavy. I wonder what's inside?
...Oh yeah...
Oh right, the souvenirs...! I should give them to her...
That's what I thought, but this stuff she's carrying...
Just looking at it, it seemed like it's at least 2 or 3 kilos...
We still have places to go.ãééMaybe I should wait until we part ways.
Here, your souvenirs. Although I couldn't get what you wanted...
How about this! Limited edition regional robot model available only in Kyoto!
Ah... Not bad...
This model does indeed make my heart just leap! It's brimming with an aura of the old capital, but...
Oh? You don't like it?
By no means! That's not it.
Then what is it?
I'm beyond grateful for your good will, but I am in no position to accept it at the present time.
At the present time? Ah, because you're going shopping afterwards, so it will unduly increase your total cargo?
It's all right. I'll hold on to it until you're done shopping.
No, it's not that...
What is it? Just tell me.
If I accept it, it might 【never come true】.
What    are    you    saying!?
What does that even mean?
If you don't like the gift... you should just say so, if it was because I didn't get what you asked.
No, that's nowhere close to the case!
I have the utmost gratitude for your gift.
But, for now it's not possible for me to accept...
Hmm...
Looks like it's not because she doesn't like the souvenir...
But if that's the case, I have no idea what's going on.
It'll "never come true" if she accepts it... what's up with that?
This can't be counted as compensation...
As a replacement...
What!? Don't suddenly place those bags on the table!
Well, it's been on my mind from the start, but what's inside?
Nothing much! It is just my trifling gift.
Saori rummaged through her backpack and took out something...
Th-This is...!?
It is as you see,  my humble collection!
All of them rare and premium goods...
...It may not be much, but I gather that Kyousuke-shi would be interested in it.
This development is too sudden, and I can't get a grip. Can you explain what's going on from the beginning?
Well, it is like this and that, et cetera...
I see, so that's why it's like this and that...
...Tsk, this isn't a manga or game, how would I know!
Hahaha!
Damn... This person's having fun at my expense...
...I took a look at another one on the table.
Each and every one of them are either limited editions or out of print; they are basically collector's items.
This figure is so hard to obtain that you can only find it in auctions...
And this game is autographed by the voice actress...?!
Aside from that, there are two beam sabers sticking out of her backpack...
It's as if the pair of white blades are extending to the heavens...
...No, wait. I have seen this somewhere...
What? It's not part of the trophy rewards from that competition?
No, no, that was just for the sabers.
Even so, I have no idea what Saori's intentions are, letting go of all these collectible goods...
Isn't this the tournament prize from before? We split it among ourselves.
That's right! One of the finest pieces in my collection, filled with memories from that day.
Aren't these all the things that you treasure the most?
Yes, certainly.
Don't say it so lightly.
If it's that important, then keep it properly, and don't just give it to others.
...Kyousuke-shi!
Wh-What is it, getting serious all of a sudden...
It is precisely because these are 【truly valuable things】, that I would like you to have them.
...Huh?
Wait, I don't get it at all.
Now now, at any rate...
